conference_name: SPE Asia Pacific Oil & Gas Conference and Exhibition 2026
venue: Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, Brisbane, Australia.
accommodation: Official room block at Rydges South Bank Brisbane, 9 Glenelg St, South Brisbane QLD 4101; rates for 10–18 Oct 2026: King AUD 309, Twin AUD 319, Balcony King AUD 324.
overview: APOGCE 2026 is SPE's Asia-Pacific upstream energy technical conference covering exploration, production, energy transition, technical innovation and industry collaboration, with technical sessions, panels, plenaries, ePosters, educational programmes and an exhibition.
call_for_papers: SPE technical-paper and abstract programme for APOGCE 2026, including accepted technical papers and the Asia Pacific Regional Student Paper Contest; conference programme lists paper IDs and authors for accepted presentations.
fees_and_pricing: Full Conference Standard: SPE Member USD 1,020; Non-member USD 1,170; Speaker/Author/Committee/Session Chair USD 960. One-day: Member USD 665; Non-member USD 715. Student registration complimentary. Optional dinners, luncheons, tables and sponsorship packages are NOT included as attendee registration fees.
program_agenda: 13 Oct: 08:30–08:45 Welcome to Country; 08:45–09:00 Welcome and Opening Address; 09:00–10:30 Executive Plenary; 11:15–12:45 technical sessions; 14:00–15:30 technical sessions; 15:30–16:00 coffee break; 16:00–17:30 panels. Additional technical, panel, poster and educational programming continues 14–15 Oct.
keynote_speakers: The Honourable Dale Last — Minister for Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing, Regional and Rural Development, Queensland Government; Brett Darley — COO, Australia and PNG Upstream Oil and Gas, Santos; Steve Trench — EVP Operations & Technical Services, Santos; Jennifer Miskimins — 2026 SPE President; Khoo Choo Beng — South Central Asset Manager, Shell QGC; Ajay Nalonnil — Managing Director ANP Geozone, Baker Hughes.
technical_committee: Conference Chair: Steve Trench — Santos. Technical Programme Co-Chairs: Bre Murillo — Santos; Pankaj Bhavnani — Shell QGC. Committee members include Aryan Sarlak — Actenum; Mohamed Osama Abd El-Meguid — ADNOC Onshore; Abbas Zeinijahromi and Alireza Salmachi — Adelaide University; Abhishek Rajora — Arrow Energy; Chris Mijnssen — Arrow Energy; Kevin Lay — AWT International.

venue: San Jose Convention Center, 150 W San Carlos St, San Jose, CA 95113.

overview: Two-day open-source AI conference hosted by the PyTorch Foundation for AI researchers, developers and practitioners, covering PyTorch and ecosystem projects such as vLLM, DeepSpeed, Ray, Helion and Safetensors through keynotes, technical talks, posters and workshops.
call_for_papers: 2026 CFP accepted session proposals and poster submissions. Program Committee review ran 8–23 Jun for sessions and 28 Jul–3 Aug for posters; session schedule announced 21 Jul and poster schedule 18 Aug.
fees_and_pricing: Conference registration: Early USD 479 (11 Apr–31 Jul); Standard USD 639 (1 Aug–4 Sep); Late USD 799 (5 Sep–11 Oct). Researcher/student rate published at USD 249 where eligible.
program_agenda: 20 Oct schedule begins with registration at 07:30; keynote welcome at 09:00; PyTorch Updates at 09:15 followed by keynote and technical programming. Two-day schedule includes keynotes, technical tracks, posters and workshops through 21 Oct.
keynote_speakers: Mark Collier — Executive Director, PyTorch Foundation; Brian Stevens — SVP and AI CTO, Red Hat; Bill Jia — VP Engineering, Core ML/AI, Google Cloud; Joelle Pineau — Chief AI Officer, Cohere; Alban Desmaison — Meta; Mazin Gilbert — Executive Director, Agentic AI Foundation; Sara Hooker — CEO & Co-Founder, Adaption; Ujval Kapasi — VP AI & HPC Frameworks/Libraries, NVIDIA; Chris Lattner — EVP Advanced AI Software and Platforms, Qualcomm.
technical_committee: Program Chairs: Jeff Daily — AMD Fellow, AMD; Alban Desmaison — Research Engineer, Meta; Mike Ruberry — Distinguished Engineer, NVIDIA. 2026 Program Committee includes Adrian Abeyta — Red Hat; Gnanaguruparan Aishvaryaadevi — Apple; Gaurav Arora — Pinterest; Piotr Bialecki — NVIDIA; Carol Chen — Red Hat; Andrea Frittoli — IBM; Digant Desai — Meta; Sayce Falk — Google; and additional named reviewers on the conference-specific committee page.
sponsors: Official PyTorch Foundation 2026 conference materials identify Google, Arm and Red Hat among Diamond/Platinum supporters.

conference_name: URTeC Latin America Unconventional Resources Summit 2026
venue: Marriott Buenos Aires Downtown, Buenos Aires, Argentina.
accommodation: Official event hotel: Marriott Buenos Aires Downtown. Special Classic Room rate USD 215/night for the event period, with breakfast, spa and Wi-Fi; organizer housing information covers 30 Nov–2 Dec and notes applicable VAT rules.
organizer: URTeC / AAPG and SPE, hosted by YPF
overview: Executive-level Latin America unconventional-resources summit focused on Vaca Muerta and regional development, bringing operators, technology providers, investors and technical leaders together for strategy, subsurface, completions, infrastructure, LNG and investment discussions.
fees_and_pricing: Early Bird through 2 Nov: Professional Nonmember USD 1,095; Member USD 995; One-Day USD 595; Academic USD 395; Exhibition Only USD 195. Standard: Professional Nonmember USD 1,195; Member USD 1,095; One-Day USD 695; Academic USD 495; Exhibition Only USD 195. The previously extracted USD 8,200 figure is NOT an attendee registration fee.
program_agenda: 1 Dec: 09:00–09:30 Welcome; 09:30–10:00 keynote by Horacio Marín; 10:00–11:15 Vaca Muerta panel; 11:45–12:30 technical session; 12:30–14:00 lunch; 14:00–15:30 technical session; 16:30–17:30 reservoir-to-completion panel; 17:30–19:00 reception. 2 Dec: sessions from 09:00 through 17:30 plus student/young-professional programming 18:00–20:00.
keynote_speakers: Horacio Marín — CEO, YPF; Fausto Caretta — Upstream Managing Director, Pan American Energy; Fernanda Raggio — Exploration Director, YPF; Ricardo Veiga — Exploration Senior Director, Tecpetrol; Bob Fryklund — Chief Upstream Strategist, S&P Global; Lucas Pigliacampo — CTO, Tenaris; Ricardo Ferreiro — President E&P, Tecpetrol; Matías Weissel — COO, Vista Energy.
technical_committee: Event programme leadership/chairs include Carlos Macellari — AAPG Chair; Alejandro Lerza — SPE Chair; Fernanda Raggio — YPF Chair. These are edition-specific Latin America summit roles and are not copied from the general URTeC 2026 committee.
sponsors: YPF — Principal Sponsor / host organization for the Latin America summit.

accommodation: RSNA official hotel program is managed with onPeak and offers nearly 60 hotels with advertised savings up to 30%; hotel reservation deadline is 11 Nov 2026 and reservations generally require a one-night room-and-tax deposit.
overview: RSNA's 112th Scientific Assembly and Annual Meeting, themed 'At the Center of Care,' is a major global radiology meeting featuring scientific research, education, plenaries, specialty programming and technical exhibits across medical imaging and related technologies.
call_for_papers: RSNA 2026 accepted abstracts in two categories: science and education, including scientific presentations and education exhibits, using online submission and double-blind peer review.
fees_and_pricing: Published registration includes multiple member/nonmember and access tiers. Examples: Nonmember Physician/Physicist/Scientist — In Person + Virtual USD 2,425; In Person USD 1,405; Virtual USD 1,020; Technical Exhibits Only USD 630. Medical Imaging Professional — In Person + Virtual USD 1,015; In Person USD 500; Virtual USD 515.
program_agenda: 29 Nov: Opening Plenary 16:00–17:30 followed by Welcome Reception 17:30–18:30. Scientific sessions generally run 08:00–17:30; technical exhibits 10:00–17:00; poster sessions include morning and midday blocks. Additional plenaries include 30 Nov at 11:00 and 1 Dec at 11:00 and 13:30.
keynote_speakers: Jeffrey S. Klein, MD — President's Address; Jonathan S. Lewin, MD — Opening Session; Gwendolyn M. Bryant-Smith, MD — Monday Morning Plenary; Mark P. Bernstein, MD — Tuesday Morning Plenary; Janice M. Newsome, MD — Tuesday Afternoon Plenary.
sponsors: Optum is identified by RSNA as sponsor of the RSNA 5K Fun Run during the 2026 annual meeting.
